dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product marks icons, navigation items and avatars with a dot when something is new and with a small count when it knows how many.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a badge reads: the dot's size and offset, the count pill's minimum height, padding, offset, shape and colors, the number's text style, and the outline that separates the badge from its anchor.
rules: A badge decorates an anchor; always give it a label that reads well after the anchor's own name ("3 unread").
Use the dot for "something is new" and a count for "how many"; a count of 0 hides the badge.
container.height is a minimum: the pill grows with enlarged text.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never position a badge by hand.

size.$description: The diameter of the dot shown when there is no count.

offset.$description: How far the dot's center sits inside the anchor's top-end corner, on both axes.

height.$description: The count pill's minimum height; also its minimum width, so a single digit sits in a circle.

offset.$description: How far the center of the pill's leading circle (a container.height square at its start) sits inside the anchor's top-end corner, on both axes. A longer count grows toward the end, away from the anchor.

width.$description: Drawn outside the container (dot or pill), so it does not change the badge's size or where it sits.
